page.layout: One printed page: title page with page number at top, centred title lines, an woodcut vignette with a surrounding oval inscription, and imprint lines below. No margins with text.
page.l: Nunc in gratiam studiosæ inuentutis ista
[woodcut vignette: oval emblem with a figure on a rocky path under trees, inscribed "EST VIA · INVIA · VIRTUTI"]
page.notes: Title page with a woodcut emblem (oval inscription reading around the border, apparently "EST VIA INVIA VIRTUTI"). The page number 557 is printed at the top, set in italic and partly obscured by the scan edge. The book's top-left and left edges are cut off by the scan, so some initial letters of the title lines (e.g. "BREVIS", "MENTATIO", "NAVTICA") may be partly lost. Printed "NAVTICA" and "Anno M DC XXI" follow the original spelling. Words such as "Philosophiæ" and "inuentutis" are read as printed; the italic line "Nunc in gratiam studiosæ inuentutis ista" is slightly blurred.
